category.name: Glasshouse Ledger
category.description: Product-UI heroes where the dashboard itself is the artwork: bento grids of unequal tiles, frosted glass panes and crisp little charts. Use it for fintech, health and wealth products that need to feel modern and trustworthy at the same time.

designs.name: Halcyon Glasshouse
designs.summary: Soft lavender, peach and mint light washes behind overlapping frosted-glass dashboard cards for sleep and recovery metrics.

references.title: Sleep Tracker Widget, liquid glass health UI (Dribbble tag listing)

designs.how_to_build: Stack three or four large blurred radial blobs (filter: blur(70px)) behind the page and add a faint SVG-noise grain with multiply blend. Build cards with background rgba(255,255,255,.46), backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.5), a 1px white border and an inset top highlight. Overlap the cards at different sizes so the blur visibly picks up the colour beneath. Draw charts as inline SVG with a lavender-to-rose gradient stroke and a low-opacity area fill.

designs.name: Tallyhouse Bento
designs.summary: A pale sage page with a grid of unequal rounded tiles: one deep-forest cash chart, a marigold alert tile, a runway donut and a virtual card.

references.title: FinTech SaaS Features, Bento Grid Exploration

designs.how_to_build: Position tiles in a 12-column grid with one dark tile as the anchor and one saturated tile (marigold) for the single call-to-action metric. Keep radii at 24px and gaps at 16px, with no shadows, so the colour does the separating. Use a mono face for tiny uppercase labels and a heavy grotesk with tight tracking for numbers. Fake the highlighter with a skewed yellow bar behind a key word using isolation: isolate on the heading.

designs.name: Payload Ultramarine
designs.summary: A saturated electric-blue field with crisp white, ink and mint tiles holding approval rates, corridor speeds and a code sample that bleeds off the page.

references.title: SwiftFunds SaaS fintech landing, bento features
Premium SaaS Fintech Landing Page Design

designs.how_to_build: Fill the page with one flat saturated blue and overlay a 64px line grid masked to fade out toward the content. Set the headline very large (90px+) with letter-spacing around -0.05em and colour one phrase mint. Tiles alternate white, ink and mint with 22px radii, and the lowest tile runs off the bottom edge to suggest more below. Use Geist Mono for every label, number and the code sample.

designs.name: Meridian Pane
designs.summary: A dark teal ocean with an amber sun and three tilted, translucent glass panes stacked like layers of a balance sheet.

references.title: Premium glassmorphism dashboard with edge-to-edge line charts

designs.how_to_build: Paint the ground with two or three large radial gradients on near-black teal, then place a glowing amber orb and a teal orb so the glass has something to refract. Each pane uses rgba(190,240,232,.09), backdrop-filter: blur(22px), a 1px pale-teal border and transform: perspective(1600px) rotateY(-14deg) rotateX(4deg). Offset the panes vertically so each overlaps the one behind it. Set the headline in a light optical-size serif with one italic word.
